entities.name: Ossett Weslyn
entities.description: A minotaur clerk of Boros Legion's Sunhome Annex Four who is promoted to Wojek counterintelligence, is framed for poisonings and exposes the true culprit.

entities.name: Sergeant Embrel Skormak
entities.description: A flame-kin Boros sergeant and Ossett's boss who secretly orchestrates poisonings of Sunhome officers, including himself, to win promotion, and is extinguished.

entities.name: Aresaan
entities.description: A fallen Razia-copy angel and former Warleader with bound wings who torments Ossett, then helps expose Skormak.

entities.name: Brazer
entities.description: A haggard former Gruul defector who contacts Ossett through a coded invitation and plays Clans & Legions with her before being killed.

entities.name: Baas Solvar Radley
entities.description: A prisoner at Wargate, probably related to the Rubblebelt raider Govan Radley, whom Ossett has freed on Brazer's demand.

entities.name: Govan Radley
entities.description: A Rubblebelt raider who set off a mass chaos spell at Tin Street Market.

entities.name: Kahti
entities.description: A feral Gruul child who steals a melon, then Ossett's coin purse for the conspiracy.

entities.name: Second Lieutenant Devin Sidian
entities.description: Skormak's boss, one of three poisoned officers, who dies.

entities.name: Guildmage Rook Atalay
entities.description: A Boros guildmage who dies in the poisonings.

entities.name: Sunhome Guard Minotaur
entities.description: A gold-armored minotaur guard in league with Skormak who killed Brazer and planted evidence; she flees when exposed.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of soldiers devoted to law and order, employing Ossett, Skormak and Aresaan.

entities.name: Wojek
entities.description: The Boros peacekeeping and counterintelligence branch to which Ossett is promoted.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The feral Ravnican guild whose encampments encroach on Tenth District.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The spy guild, whose hidden codes Ossett was trained to detect and whose mind mage she suspects.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The undercity guild whose poison is used in the Boros plot.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The angel leading the Boros Legion's Parhelion.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: The angel whom Aresaan resembles, and for whom the opening move Razia's Folly is named.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: The Boros fortress with blocky towers and flaming pyres; Annex Four is a warehouse for misfits.

entities.name: Gruul Rubblebelt
entities.description: A rubble-strewn district whose dust is full of dragon bone and where Brazer's bunker sits.

entities.name: Wargate Prison Camp
entities.description: The Boros prison where Baas Solvar is held.

entities.name: Clans & Legions
entities.description: A Ravnican strategy board game, whose angel piece is used to hide poison.

events.summary: Sergeant Skormak promotes Ossett to Wojek, giving her a red cord and a sealed letter.
Ossett realizes her invitation to a reception is a coded briefing for her first counterintelligence assignment and decodes a meeting at a bunker near the Rubblebelt.
events.quote: This isn't an invitation. It's the briefing for my first assignment as a Wojek counterintelligence agent.

events.summary: Aresaan snoops over Ossett's shoulder and mocks her promotion.
events.quote: It's a fine accomplishment for someone with such weak convictions.

events.summary: In the Gruul market, Ossett catches a child thieving but pays the merchant and lets her go.
events.quote: I sigh, then let the child go.

events.summary: Ossett enters the bunker and meets her informant Brazer, who insists on playing Clans & Legions first.
events.quote: I do," he says, the weariness obvious in his raspy voice. "But first, let's play.

events.summary: Brazer reveals there is a spy in Boros Legion and demands that the prisoner Baas Solvar be freed from Wargate in exchange for the name.
events.quote: There's a spy in the Boros Legion.

events.summary: Ossett bribes Skormak's assistant to slip a release form into his signature pile, then discovers the prisoner is related to the raider Govan Radley.
events.quote: Baas Solvar isn't her full name. Baas Solvar Radley.

events.summary: Aresaan taunts Ossett while she works and Ossett decides to ignore the truth about the prisoner.
events.quote: I just need to go on ignoring the truth.

events.summary: Baas Solvar is freed. Ossett waits for Brazer at the market, and Kahti steals her coin purse while hugging her.
events.quote: Then I notice my coin purse is gone.

events.summary: Ossett returns to the bunker and finds Brazer dead with his throat slit and the angel piece of the game missing.
events.quote: Only what I find is Brazer's dead body, sitting where I'd left him, slit across his neck.

events.summary: Aresaan intercepts Ossett outside Sunhome and goes in with her to report the murder.
events.quote: I know we haven't been the most cordial of co-workers, but I'll come with you if you want

events.summary: Guards arrest Ossett for the poisonings of Skormak, Sidian and Atalay and find the poison-filled angel piece in her coin purse.
events.quote: You're suspected in the acute poisonings of Sergeant Embrel Skormak, Second Lieutenant Devin Sidian, and Guildmage Rook Atalay.

events.summary: Ossett deduces that Skormak, the only survivor, poisoned himself to gain a promotion and that the minotaur guard killed Brazer, and exposes the dust on her uniform.
events.quote: Skormak is behind this and he poisoned himself to escape the blame.

events.summary: Aresaan's fire exposes the dragon-bone Rubblebelt dust on the minotaur, who throws down the poison and flees.
events.quote: When we regain our composure, the spy is gone.

events.summary: Aresaan unbinds her wings and carries Ossett to Skormak's desk at Annex Four.
events.quote: Razor wire crumbles as she flexes her wings against it

events.summary: Skormak admits his motive, resentment that flame-kin are denied high rank, and accuses the Legion of injustice.
events.quote: Three out of thousands . Just because we were cast instead of born doesn't mean we aren't capable of performing in high ranks.

events.summary: Ossett rams Skormak into a wall and Aresaan douses him with a water elemental, extinguishing him into wet ashes.
events.quote: He smolders like a pinched wick, then dissipates into a pile of wet ashes and charred armor.

relations.note: Promoted from Annex Four to Wojek.
relations.quote: A copper token dangles from it with "Boros Wojek" printed around the rim.

relations.note: Skormak was her boss at Annex Four.
relations.quote: I've served under Sergeant Skormak, the associate director of war development

relations.note: He frames her for the poisonings and is defeated by her.
relations.quote: Annex Four wasn't good enough for you, was it?

relations.note: She starts as a nemesis but ends as an ally.
relations.quote: I've earned the trust of an angel

relations.note: Ossett believes they are probably related.
relations.quote: Most likely related to Govan Radley
